ambient: A name is read and there's a pause the length of that person.
The reading continues at the same pace.
A name you had lost arrives, correctly placed, between two you had not.
description: A list, being read at the pace a list is read at, of the people you have had. Everyone. In the order they arrived. It's accurate and it's longer than you would have said, and nothing is added after any of them.
name: The List Of Names

looks: Everyone. In order. Nothing beside the names.
It's written in one hand and the hand doesn't tire.
You're on it, once, in the correct position.
objects.name: the list

looks: Reading. Not slowly, and not fast.
They don't look up between names and they get every pronunciation right.
objects.name: the reader

weather: Quiet, with the small sounds of a room where somebody is reading.
